issues.description: The problem statement shows the state-preparation function name with a leading underscore (_construct_zero_state_prep_circuit) (problem_statement.md lines 55-60), while both the template and reference solution define the function without the underscore (construct_zero_state_prep_circuit) (template_repository/msd.py lines 27-38, solution_repository/msd.py lines 44-56). This name mismatch can confuse students about which function to implement and may cause test harnesses or auto-graders that expect the exact name from the problem text to fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the function name consistent across artifacts. Either (a) update the problem statement to reference construct_zero_state_prep_circuit (no leading underscore), or (b) rename the template/solution function to _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit and provide a compatibility alias (e.g. def _construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...): return construct_zero_state_prep_circuit(...)). Prefer (a) to match the template/solution and avoid suggesting a ‘private’ name in the assignment text.
